session_summary: As a first-time player, I selected the Moss Trail (difficulty 1) to learn the game. I successfully walked forward 12 steps, defeated 3 enemies (Goblin, Slime, and Kobold) along the way, and completed the route, earning 25 coins ending with 149 total coins and 100 HP.

observations.evidence: Play trace begins immediately with walking actions ('walk' from step 0 to 1) with no introductory tooltips, tutorial prompts, or UI guidance for a first-time session.
observations.recommendation: Add welcome tooltips or an introductory prompt at step 0 to explain movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: Moss Trail successfully served as an accessible starting route with clear progression up to step 12 completion.
observations.recommendation: Keep Moss Trail as the default recommended starting route for new players.

feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players immediately understand initial movement and combat mechanics without guessing.
feature_requests.rationale: First-time players need clear introductory cues when stepping onto their first route.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear, non-intrusive instructional text overlays or narrative hints during the first few steps of the Moss Trail.

keep: Moss Trail difficulty and pacing felt approachable for a first session.
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
